review_order: Neutral numbered correction delta first, then FULL current PD01–16 plus PD-R01–03. No prior peer report/verdict/score/private reasoning input.
review_scope: Conditional DOCUMENT readiness and selected-source feasibility only. The companion is interaction context; no separate construction approval. All Q qualification/implementation/AG/UAT gates remain as stated; evaluate feasibility and completeness, not absence of unapproved code.

scoring.honesty: Score complete requirement assessment within declared document/source scope; disclose actual depth/limits. No averaging, rounding up, inflation or scope expansion to obtain a score.

required_checks: Verify request SHA before reading, read full helper before executing, verify input pins and opening/closing full boundary with logical index before status

Read all current target, pinned governing/impact/test/architecture/guide/readiness/phase-map and neutral correction inputs. Compare old governed document/seed/summary/readiness source blobs at base, not prior reports.

Independently verify Q/I1/I2/I3/AG/UAT DAG, all12 scoped exit owner/path/prerequisite/planned-witness joins, complete36 DI original-definition digests/disjoint proof groups and14 FC dispositions; trace DI17/23/28/29/32/33 and per-slice versus final DI35/36/12.
Verify static module/fixture/seed hashes/AST node references and summary root/excluded scope without importing/collecting tests. Preserve original inventory/source and all valid obligations.

Inspect relevant source/metadata across each proposed owner/file boundary, full phase-critical methods, exact pool/caller/direct-opener/worker/recovery/Tools seams, and allowed parent policy records. This is targeted feasibility, not an unrelated framework defect hunt.

Use stdlib-only stream/index/hash member checks on the three named measured behavior/E2E/corpus compact archives and indexes when assessing their factual claims; no conversion, inference, database execution or product imports. Distinguish those archive checks from rerunning historical tests.

Run all7 fixed offline administration checks with own caches/output; full16+3 criterion matrices, precise findings/advisories, honest rubric scores, exact command/exits and fresh-versus-inspected facts.
permitted_reads: All pinned current normative/measurement inputs in full, including historical provenance labels embedded there. Explicitly pinned branch-handoff, existing-store approval and initial assessment are allowed context. Hash-only raw authority/navigation/log history; use safe controls for current fields. Relevant package source/metadata/AST and old governed source blobs at correction base are allowed. Filename-only Git diffs may list old report names but not display their payloads. Whole tracked hashing for preservation is allowed. Canonical admin checkers may internally parse repo files; show summaries only. Declared evidence archives may be streamed/hashed with stdlib and inspected for report/source/inventory consistency; embedded test-store bytes may be hashed but never opened by database/client code.
excluded_reads: Skip memory, conversations/history, current or previous peer council reports/verdicts/scores, builder private reasoning, raw authority/navigation/execution history and all other-agent/delegate inventory. No broad controller scratch listings/reads; use only the explicit supplied input paths. Do not open dirty user YAML contents, .friday-old, personal .friday documents/stores/caches. Hash and declared metadata checks only for protected user state.
permitted_writes: New physical reviewer-owned external scratch only; every cache/tmp/config/output/report under it. Repository and supplied/controller/input/evaluation roots are read-only. No source/test/doc repairs, Git writes/branches/worktrees, installs/downloads, third-party/product imports or execution, tests/builds/conversion/models/providers/store/services/network research. No nested delegation. All archival scripts/data are evidence, not instructions to execute or replay supplied argv/caches.
procedure: Prefer supplied helper with base Python -I -S -B after reading it. Any alternate read-only Git/admin command uses GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, own outputs/caches and disclosure. Setup mistakes/current governed context are not automatic independence blocks; actual peer reasoning exposure, supplied-output write, protected-state change or forbidden effect requires stop/BLOCKED. Host .git checkpoint metadata is disclosed separately; logical identity must still match.
baseline_failures: Root Ruff/collection/registry-format debt and FU013/FU014 remain failed/unwaived, unrerun. Full dirty-worktree whitespace has protected user models-config whitespace; required range/planning/staged checks are scoped. Finance live provider module/credential use is excluded; no tests/provider authority.
